title: You choose what happens to the portal login when two contacts are merged
text: Before, merging two contacts always deleted the login of the contact being removed, even when that was the only one that worked, and the person was locked out. The Logins step of the merge window now lets you choose. If only the removed contact has a login, you move it to the kept contact (same email and password) or remove it. If both have one, nothing is preselected: you pick which one the person keeps, and each shows when it last signed in. The chosen login is moved and checked first; the other is deleted only after. If something fails, the window says so plainly.
points: Open a contact, press Delete / Merge, pick the other contact
In the Logins step, choose which login the person keeps using
Type MERGE. The chosen login now belongs to the kept contact

steps.name: See both logins
steps.detail: The Logins step lists each login and what will happen to it.

steps.name: You choose
steps.detail: Move the removed contact's login, keep the kept one, or remove it.

steps.name: The chosen login moves first
steps.detail: It is pointed at the kept contact and read back to check.

steps.name: Only then are the others deleted
steps.detail: If the move fails, nothing is deleted.
